body: I have a wool sensitivity and this one doesn't bother me at all, must be a finer knit. The fold sits nicely without collapsing and charcoal goes with basically everything in my closet.
Fit felt tight the first couple wears but it's relaxed a little with use, sits normal on my head now. Rib knit looks good folded or pulled down long, nice for the price.
Nothing fancy, just a well made wool beanie that keeps my ears warm on the walk to the train. Charcoal is a true dark grey, not black like some listings show.

does the job for keeping warm but the knit feels thinner and less premium than i pictured for what i paid. fold stays in place fine though and it hasnt stretched out of shape yet after a few weeks of wear

He's picky about hats sitting too high on his head but this one folds down enough to cover his ears properly without looking bulky. Simple packaging but the beanie itself feels well made, he's worn it every cold morning since.
Warm, fits well, no complaints beyond a couple loose fibers I trimmed off after unboxing.

This is much lighter than the charcoal shown in the photos, closer to a medium heather grey on mine. Wouldn't have ordered it if I'd known, since I specifically wanted something darker to match a jacket. Warmth is fine, just not what I expected color wise.

I go through a lot of cheap beanies every winter and this is holding up noticeably better after a month of near daily wear. It hasn't lost shape or started pilling on the fold yet, which is usually where mine fall apart first.

package showed up in two days which i wasnt expecting. beanie itself is comfortable and warm, only thing is it sits a touch loose on me and slides back a bit if im moving around a lot outside, might just be my head shape though

This has basically replaced the two other beanies I own since it's warmer and doesn't leave that annoying line across my forehead after a few hours. The rib knit has enough stretch that it doesn't feel tight even over a hood. My only small gripe is a couple of the wool fibers shed onto my dark coat the first couple wears, settled down after that though.
Not much to say beyond that it's a well fitted, warm beanie in a genuinely dark charcoal. Good gift option too since one size covers most people I've given similar hats to before.
